description_en: Queries the data integration synchronization tasks associated with the target data source
description_zh: 查看目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-ref-di-sync-tasks --project-id 10000 --datasource-name mysql_datasource --task-type DI_OFFLINE --ref-type from --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRefDISyncTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the target data source that you want to query. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211431.html operation to obtain the data source name
parameters.help_zh: 需要查看的目标数据源名称。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/211431.html接口获取数据源名称
parameters.name: datasource_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data integration synchronization task associated with the target data source. Valid values:
DI_OFFLINE: Offline data integration synchronization task.
DI_REALTIME: Real-time data integration synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据源所关联的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：
DI_OFFLINE：表示数据集成离线同步任务。
DI_REALTIME：表示数据集成实时同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the role of the target data source in the data integration synchronization task. Valid values:
from: The target data source serves as the source of the data integration synchronization task.
to: The target data source serves as the destination of the data integration synchronization task
parameters.help_zh:
选择目标数据源作为数据集成同步任务的源端或目的端。取值如下：
from：目标数据源作为数据集成同步任务的源端。
to：目标数据源作为数据集成同步任务的目的端
parameters.name: ref_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

DISyncTasks.description_en: The array of returned data. Typically, a target data source is associated with multiple data integration synchronization tasks. When you call the ListRefDISyncTasks operation to query the synchronization tasks associated with the target data source, the returned result is an array of the associated synchronization tasks. The following information is an example of a synchronization task in the array
DISyncTasks.description_zh:
返回数据结果的数组信息。
通常，目标数据源会关联多个数据集成同步任务，调用ListRefDISyncTasks接口查询目标数据源关联的同步任务时，返回的结果为目标数据源所关联的同步任务的数组。如下信息为数组中一个同步任务的信息示例

items.description_en: The array of returned data. Typically, a target data source is associated with multiple data integration synchronization tasks. When you call the ListRefDISyncTasks operation to query the synchronization tasks associated with the target data source, the returned result is an array of the associated synchronization tasks. The following information is an example of a synchronization task in the array
items.description_zh:
返回数据结果的数组信息。
通常，目标数据源会关联多个数据集成同步任务，调用ListRefDISyncTasks接口查询目标数据源关联的同步任务时，返回的结果为目标数据源所关联的同步任务的数组。如下信息为数组中一个同步任务的信息示例

DiDestinationDatasource.description_en: The destination data source of the current synchronization task associated with the target data source. If the current synchronization task has multiple destination data sources, multiple destination data sources are returned in a JSON array, such as ["odps_writer", "mysql"]. If the RefType parameter is set to to, which means the target data source serves as the destination of the data integration synchronization task, the value of this parameter is the target data source itself
DiDestinationDatasource.description_zh:
目标数据源所关联的当前同步任务的目的端数据源。
如果当前同步任务存在多个目的端数据源，则会以JSON数组的形式返回多个目的端数据源。例如，[\"odps_writer\", \"mysql\"]。
当RefType参数取值为to时，即目标数据源作为数据集成同步任务的目的端，则当前参数的返回结果为目标数据源本身

DiSourceDatasource.description_en: The source data source of the current synchronization task associated with the target data source. If the current synchronization task has multiple source data sources, multiple source data sources are returned in a JSON array, such as ["odps_writer", "mysql"]. If the RefType parameter is set to from, which means the target data source serves as the source of the data integration synchronization task, the value of this parameter is the target data source itself
DiSourceDatasource.description_zh:
目标数据源所关联的当前同步任务的源端数据源。
如果当前同步任务存在多个源端数据源，则会以JSON数组的形式返回多个源端数据源。例如，[\"odps_writer\", \"mysql\"]。
当RefType参数取值为from时，即目标数据源作为数据集成同步任务的源端，则当前参数的返回结果为目标数据源本身

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the current data integration synchronization task associated with the target data source
NodeId.description_zh: 目标数据源所关联的当前数据集成同步任务的任务ID

NodeName.description_en: The name of the current data integration synchronization task associated with the target data source
NodeName.description_zh: 目标数据源所关联的当前数据集成同步任务的任务名称
